purpose: Desktop overview direction before implementation; all mock figures are illustrative
promptBrief: 1440 desktop South African Capitec-inspired operations dashboard. White sidebar with Overview, Transactions, Fraud checks, Fraud rules, Statements, Testing. Light grey #f7f8fa background, white cards, navy headings, blue pill controls, Nunito Sans. Overview header, auto-refresh status and pause, account filter and Today/7 days/30 days controls. Four metric cards. Transaction trend with Count/Value toggle, fraud status donut, category spending bars, incoming per-minute stacked Bank/Card/Wallet bars. Clear drilldowns and expandable data views. No Kafka, SQL or internal implementation text. Use illustrative data.
implementationChanges: Awaiting check uses a neutral color instead of red
Donut total is labelled transactions because it includes pending checks
Chart tables preserve exact monetary values
All runtime values come from the authenticated account-scoped API
